title: High-efficiency and environmentally friendly copper recovery from waste copper clad laminate and its pyrolysis behavior through a novel low-temperature rotary furnace process
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48498-48508
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06865G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Meng Tian, Xianglan Zhang
The PL-WCCL is employed in a rotary furnace to conduct low-temperature pyrolysis reactions. This approach enables the efficient separation of the metallic and non-metallic parts of the raw materials and significantly reduces the subsequent steps.
